text: Moyn is fair to the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, adopted on the tenth of December nineteen forty eight. Its first article announced status equality, everyone born free and equal in dignity and rights, and after racism and genocide that was revolutionary. But it implies nothing more. There is no ceiling on the wealth gap; even the UN's expert on poverty admits there is no explicitly stated right to equality. His thought experiment: one man could own everything, an absolute overlord, without violating human rights, so long as everyone's basic rights were met. Even perfectly realised human rights are compatible with radical inequality.
